failure_reason: Site is unreachable from this workstation through every compliant access tier. Exhausted in order: (1) plain curl -4 (timeout) and curl_cffi across 6 TLS/browser impersonation profiles - chrome124, chrome131, safari17_0, safari18_0_ios, safari184_ios, firefox133 (all timeout or connection-refused); (2) IPv6 direct - not available, no AAAA record; (3) Playwright/Chromium via CDP - net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED on robots.txt; (4) Claude-in-Chrome (the user's real Chrome browser) - navigation to robots.txt also failed, frame showed a browser-level connection error page.
